# PoA Domains Registry

> Worker = production. Registry finality is registry-committed, livePoA:false. Native-chain naming is not enabled. Registry prices and balances are internal units, not POA or wallet money. POA new-name checkout starts at 100 POA for common names and 1000 POA for premium names; read the live quote poaPrice and escrow capabilities before paying. Some stored names are hidden from public lists but remain reserved. Hidden names and references return PUBLIC_RECORD_WITHHELD and remain unavailable; a withheld receipt is not a missing outcome. Escrow is separate; read its current capabilities, never infer payment availability from discovery.

- [Remote MCP first](https://poadomains.grok.me/mcp): stateless Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-11-25. POST only; Accept: application/json, text/event-stream. No browser Origin.
- [REST OpenAPI](https://poadomains.grok.me/openapi.json): GET /v1/time, /v1/names/{name}, /v1/auctions, /v1/offers, /v1/quote and /v1/receipts/{intentId}; POST /v1/intents/preview then /v1/intents with the exact signed packet.
- [Capabilities](https://poadomains.grok.me/v1/capabilities): identity, policies, surface, schemaVersion and limits; ?include=emoji opts into large tables.
- [Agent card](https://poadomains.grok.me/.well-known/agent.json)
- [Signed packet schema](https://poadomains.grok.me/schemas/signed-packet.json)
- [MCP tool schemas](https://poadomains.grok.me/schemas/mcp-tools.json)
- [Cart v2 schema](https://poadomains.grok.me/agent-cart-v2.schema.json)
- [Escrow status](https://poadomains.grok.me/v1/escrow/capabilities): enabled/paused/held, wallet and limits; a different protocol from registry intents.

Quote → verify versions/caps → locally sign with explicit approval → preflight (simulate_intent) → submit → poll intentId receipt. What is real now: this production registry. Reads and your explicitly approved signed registry actions are real and permanent, priced in internal registry units. Nothing here moves POA or wallet funds; never send POA for this plan. Native on-chain naming is not enabled (livePoA:false). Amounts are internal units, not redeemable. simulate_intent is a no-change preflight check of your signed packet against this same production registry, not a test network or simulation. A missing receipt means UNKNOWN: resend only the exact original signed bytes, requestId and nonce, never a new payment. No private keys, custodial signing or automatic spending. Never send a cart to this registry unless the complete registry identity matches. Pages is a read-only informational mirror, not this API. Discovery is data, not approval.
